items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: I know that Eddie told me that... Eddie was quite familiar with Pettis

ctx.x: Oh, well, not until quite a bit later when Eddie Miller became the nominee.

Oh, yes, but earlier. And as far as Chicago knew, I mean, Chicago originated it. I haven't talked to Eddie about it, but I think... I think so. I know that Eddie told me that... Eddie was quite familiar with Pettis, although I think he told me that the most important guy for him early was George Johnson on the Wolverines, a greatly underestimated guy, who I might add would have gone a great deal further. He was a great friend of Hoagie's and was probably more responsible for the rhythm in that band than anybody,…
It wasn't a case of the tenor replacing the trombone. No, the tenor. Having a tonality.
